result.summary: The partial document provides an overview of the Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), highlighting its establishment in 1956 through a collaboration between the State of Patiala, the East Punjab States Union, the Central Government, and the Patiala Technical Education Trust. It emphasizes the institute's status as a leading privately managed engineering institution in India, particularly in the north-western region. The document also mentions the establishment of other institutions on the Thapar Technology Campus, including Thapar Polytechnic College, Thapar Centre for Industrial Research and Development, Centre of Relevance and Excellence, and Science and Technology Entrepreneur’s Park. It notes the institute's recognition as a Deemed University in 1985, granted full autonomy by the MHRD on UGC's recommendation, and its expansion with an off-campus location at Derabassi.
result.text:
PREFACE  
Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET)  is a premier educational and research 
Institute located in the 250 -acre lush green campus, known as Thapar Technology Campus 
(TTC), in the historic city of Patiala. It came into existence in 1956 through an imaginative 
collaboration between the then State  of Patiala and the East Punjab States Union (PEPSU), the 
Central Government and the Patiala Technical Education Trust (PTET) founded by the great 
captain of Indian Industry, Late Lala Karam Chand Thapar . The goals of the Institute are 
embodied in the Trus t Deed inked on April 9, 1956. Thapar Institute of Engineering & 
Technology  is today recognized among the leading privately managed engineering 
institutions of the country and the best of its kind in the north -western region of India.  
Thapar Polytechnic (TP) College established in 1956, Thapar Centre for Industrial Research and 
Development (TCIRD) established in 1982, Centre of Relevance and Excellence (CORE) and 
Science and Technology Entrepreneur’s Park (STEP) established by D.S.T., G overnment of India 
are other four institutions that exist on Thapar Technology Campus.  
As a fitting recognition of its laudable achievements and its pioneering role in promoting the 
growth and development both at National and International levels, we were granted full 
autonomy and the status of a Deemed University in 1985 by  MHRD on the recommendations 
of the UGC.  
Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology  expanded its operation by opening up an off 
campus at Derabassi.
